svg.title: Ground-penetrating radar cart — Jarðsjá á vagni
svg.desc: A low wheeled radar housing has a rear push handle and a broad scanning arc entering the ground below.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-ground-penetrating-radar","label_en":"Ground-penetrating radar cart","label_is":"Jarðsjá á vagni","section":"03","category_en":"Site setup, surveying and ground investigation","category_is":"Aðstaða, landmælingar og jarðkönnun","batch":2,"tags":["ground-investigation","geophysics"],"description":"A low wheeled radar housing has a rear push handle and a broad scanning arc entering the ground below.","design_note":"The close-to-ground sensing body and subsurface scan arc distinguish a radar cart from a transport trolley.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
